moments.text: IR view with a cyan crosshair looking down at a hazy grey sea surface; black boxes mask the corners.
After ~0.4 s of dark and flat grey frames the view jumps closer: rippled water framed by curved light bands at the sides.
The bands vanish and a small white shape with short arms shows below left of the crosshair; it wanders around the centre, mostly to its left.
The display switches to a blue-tinted daylight camera: a small dark shape sits right on the crosshair.
Back to IR: a bright white glow fills the centre and the shape is no longer visible.
A square track box locks on the crosshair beside the small white spot; it breaks up at 1:42, returns, and drops again at 2:12.8.
The spot slips away right of the crosshair, reaching the right edge, while the sensor chases it back toward centre.
Zoom step: the white shape is now a larger blotch with short arms, held below or left of the crosshair; at 3:29 it looks rounder.
The view widens again; from 3:51 the track box is back on the crosshair while large white patches slide through the lower frame.
The box is gone and the picture turns blocky and speckled; the crosshair breaks up and no object stands out to the end.
